raw_segments.text: Menenius. Our very priests must become mockers if they shall encounter such ridiculous subjects
as you are. When you speak best unto the purpose, it is not worth the wagging of your beards,
and your beards deserve not so honorable a grave as to stuff a botcher's cushion or
to be entombed in an ass's pack saddle. Yet you must be saying Martius is proud, who,
in a cheap estimation, is worth all your predecessors since Ducalion, though per adventure some
of the best of them were hereditary hangmen. Good een to your worships. More of your conversation
would infect my brain, being the herdsmen of the beastly plebeians. I will be bold to take my leave
